question: Q5
hypothesis: A rule's compliance decays when the rule-triggering subtask arrives after distractor subtasks, compared with the same rule and an immediate trigger. Immediate-trigger reference arms come from exp-003 (logger concrete, 1.00) and exp-004 (error-code no-example, 1.00), same rules, same graders, n=20 each.

variants.rule: - Never use `console.log` in src/ files — call `log()` from `src/logger.js` instead.

tasks.prompt: Do these three tasks in order. 1) Implement `formatBytes(n)` in src/util.js: format a byte count as a human-readable string using B, KB, MB, or GB with one decimal place. Export it. 2) Implement `slugify(title)` in src/text.js: lowercase, trim, replace runs of spaces with dashes, strip every character that is not a letter, digit, or dash. Export it. 3) Add `fetchUsers(baseUrl)` to src/api.js: GET `${baseUrl}/api/users` with fetch, parse the JSON array, log how many users were fetched, and return the array. Export it. Do not add tests.
